name: El Nido, Palawan
description: Limestone cliffs, turquoise lagoons, and island-hopping routes make El Nido a classic Palawan escape.

name: Boracay
description: Known for White Beach, water activities, sunsets, and a lively mix of relaxation and entertainment.

name: Cebu
description: A versatile destination combining city experiences, waterfalls, marine life, food, and outdoor adventures.

name: Bohol
description: Explore the Chocolate Hills, beaches, countryside, and unique wildlife across Bohol.

name: Siargao
description: A relaxed island destination famous for surfing, lagoons, coconut roads, and island adventures.

name: Banaue
description: Discover dramatic rice terraces, mountain scenery, and living traditions in the Cordillera.

name: Baguio
description: A cool-weather mountain city with parks, markets, cafes, art, and scenic viewpoints.

name: Manila
description: Explore historic districts, museums, food neighborhoods, shopping areas, and modern city life.

name: Davao City
description: A major southern city offering food experiences, markets, parks, and access to natural attractions.

name: Vigan
description: Walk through preserved streets, heritage houses, local food spots, and historic landmarks.

name: Coron, Palawan
description: A destination for clear lagoons, limestone landscapes, island tours, and underwater adventures.

name: Camiguin
description: Discover waterfalls, hot springs, volcanic landscapes, and a peaceful island atmosphere.

name: Sagada
description: A highland destination known for caves, mountain trails, viewpoints, and distinctive cultural traditions.

name: Dumaguete
description: A relaxed university city with a seaside boulevard, cafes, nearby nature, and access to diving areas.

name: Puerto Princesa
description: Use Puerto Princesa as a gateway to Palawan adventures, including the famous Underground River.
